description: This source file defines functions for setting thread priorities and schedulers on a Raspberry Pi 4 platform, including handling real-time priorities and scheduling policies.

methods.name: SetIdleScheduler
methods.description: Sets the thread scheduler to SCHED_IDLE with priority 0.

methods.name: SetOtherScheduler
methods.description: Sets the thread scheduler to SCHED_OTHER with priority 0.

methods.name: SetRoundRobinScheduler
methods.description: Sets the thread scheduler to SCHED_RR with a specified priority, considering system limits.

methods.name: ThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets thread priority based on the provided SbThreadPriority enum.

methods.name: SbThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Public API to set thread priority, calls internal ThreadSetPriority.

methods.name: SbThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread priority based on scheduler settings.
